description_en: Deletes a rule that is used to dynamically add the instances of a service to an application group
description_zh: 调用DeleteMonitorGroupDynamicRule接口删除指定应用分组的动态规则
name: DeleteMonitorGroupDynamicRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The service to which the rule applies. Valid values: ecs, rds, and slb
parameters.help_zh: 动态规则对应的云产品类型，取值：ecs、rds、slb
parameters.name: category
